Name: GARAGE_CAMERA_ANIM_PARAM_ST
Description: Garage camera animations. Each row holds 16 sets (0 to 15) of start and end camera animations with their fade, blur and lane camera settings.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: 0: Start Camera ID
Fields.Description: Camera ID to play at start.

Fields.Name: 0: End Camera ID
Fields.Description: Camera ID to play at end.

Fields.Name: 0: Play Immediately
Fields.Description: ON: play immediately. OFF: wait for the system wait time, then play.

Fields.Name: 0: Fade
Fields.Description: Fade in and out in step with the camera animation. Without an animation, a fixed system time is used.

Fields.Name: 0: Blur
Fields.Description: Blur the screen in step with the camera animation. Without an animation, a fixed system time is used.

Fields.Name: 0: Cancel Other Animations on Switch
Fields.Description: ON: cancel the end animation of the previous camera when this camera starts playing.

Fields.Name: 0: Screen Effects Only
Fields.Description: ON: only the screen effect animation is played; the camera animation is used only for its animation frames.

Fields.Name: 0: Fix Viewpoint Height
Fields.Description: ON: when the animation moves the viewpoint dummy poly up or down, only its offset from the reference height is used.

Fields.Name: 0: Lane Camera: Initial Frame
Fields.Description: Initial frame of lane camera animation when switching cameras.

Fields.Name: 0: Base Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Play the camera based on the specified dummy polygon (i.e. playback position offset).

Fields.Name: 0: Lane Camera: Viewpoint Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the lane camera's viewpoint, given as the last two digits of 1017xx. -1: the player's AC.

Fields.Name: 0: Lane Camera: Point ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID that the lane camera point refers to, given as the last digit of 10160x.

Fields.Name: 0: Lane Camera: Viewpoint Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID of the lane camera's viewpoint. -1: dummy poly 899 on the head part of the player's AC.
